item.title: Energy Sec. Wright says 'we're open to all ideas' amid calls to suspend gas tax: Full interview
item.description: Energy Secretary Chris Wright tells Meet the Press that the Trump administration’s priority is ending Iran’s nuclear program and restoring secure shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, while ongoing tensions could keep gas prices elevated in the short term.

item.title: Iran Reportedly Responds to US Peace Proposal
item.description: The Iranian government has reportedly sent a response to a United States peace proposal. Iranian media reports that Iran has now passed its response to Pakistani mediators, saying it focuses on ending the war and safety of maritime traffic in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Molly Hunter reports for Sunday TODAY.

item.title: Iran has responded to U.S. proposal in peace talks, state media reports
item.description: Iran has responded to a U.S. proposal to bring an end to the war in the Middle East, Iranian state media reported Sunday
